title: Automated flag created
description: A machine-generated flag entered the moderation queue as a report. The subject is the report the flag became.

report_id.description: The report the flag was recorded as.

priority.description: Priority the flag entered the queue with.

user_id.description: For content flags, the owning user if known.

classifier.description: Name of the classifier that produced the flag, such as toxicity_v3.

score.description: Classifier score in the classifier's own scale. Stored as-is.

game_id.description: The reporting game, when the flag came from a game server.
